title: TaskHive — Scalable Task Management Backend
description: A production-style backend system for team-based project and task management, designed with strong domain modeling, clean architecture principles, and high test coverage.
results: Designed a modular backend architecture with clear domain boundaries (teams, projects, tasks) to ensure scalability and maintainability
Implemented REST APIs with strict business logic enforcement, role-based access control, and stateless JWT authentication
Achieved ~96% test coverage with unit and integration tests, ensuring reliability of core business workflows
Built a production-ready environment using Docker, PostgreSQL, and structured logging with health checks
Handled complex data relationships and integrity constraints across multi-tenant team-based systems
